source_snapshot.test_set: Power Supply - L10 : CRPS -Latch on fault
source_snapshot.procedure: Confirm SUT configuration, clear logs, then check the configuration block type based on 'Table 1248 Configuration block types' and collect results/photos and unexpected logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Configuration block type base on Table 1248 Configuration block types
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: A PSU vendor configuration-block decoder and printed specification table are required; the agent was assumed unable to access PSU configuration blocks.

original_test_intent.purpose: Read the `configBlockType` field from the CRPS latch-on-fault configuration block and prove that the decoded value maps to the latch-on-fault block type in the exact applicable configuration-block type table.
original_test_intent.target: The latch-on-fault configuration block of each owner-designated CRPS PSU identity/firmware/configuration image; not an arbitrary PMBus register, another block type or a different PSU revision.
original_test_intent.scope: A vendor-approved read-only block decode, field extraction and specification comparison. For OCP M-CRPS v1.00 RC4 specifically, the field is at block offset `0002h` and Table 12-48 assigns `0008h` to Latch on Fault condition; those constants are conditional on confirmed specification applicability.
original_test_intent.operation: Identify the PSU and applicable specification/configuration format, use the matching vendor decoder and approved read-only interface to locate the latch-on-fault block, preserve the raw bytes plus decoded field, compare the value to the correct table entry, repeat the approved read for consistency, and check PSU/BMC health without writing or resetting anything.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One read/compare per required PSU/configuration instance, with one identical confirmation read; the source lists five attended and five machine minutes and no stress duration.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The decoded block-type value exactly matches the latch-on-fault entry in the applicable signed specification, the raw/decoded mapping is traceable, repeated readout is consistent, and PSU/BMC health is unchanged.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: PSU stable identity and firmware/VPD/configuration revision, authoritative specification title/version/table, tool name/version/hash, approved interface/command and target, raw block bytes, field offset/width/endianness, decoded value, expected entry, comparison, repeat-read consistency and before/after PSU/BMC/SEL evidence.
ambiguities: The source omits the document title/revision, PSU applicability, block location/interface, field width/endianness, decoder and command parameters.
The text 'Table 1248' lacks the section-table separator and should not be treated as an independently identified table.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly rejects BLOCKED, requires the vendor tool/table/field mapping and read-only approval, preserves logs and prohibits guessed PMBus access. It repeats 'Table 1248' without resolving the official M-CRPS table numbering or the conditional expected block-type value.

applicable_history.decision: A clear read/decode/compare purpose with provisionable vendor tool and specification is REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, not permanent BLOCKED.

The related CRPS offset-field calibration case established that missing block maps/decoders are provisionable readiness dependencies and raw reads cannot establish acceptance without the matching spec.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Capability remains REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION. V3 resolves the likely table-number transcription to official OCP M-CRPS Table 12-48 and documents the conditional `0002h`/`0008h` mapping, while requiring the owner to prove that exact specification revision applies before using those constants.

available_now: The field-level read/compare purpose and latch-on-fault block identity are understandable.
Official OCP M-CRPS v1.00 RC4 provides a concrete candidate mapping: latch-on-fault Table 12-57 places `configBlockType` at `0002h`, and Table 12-48 maps Latch on Fault condition to `0008h`.
PSU/BMC identity, health and existing logs can be collected without accessing configuration bytes.
missing_inputs: Owner confirmation that OCP M-CRPS v1.00 RC4, or another exact document/revision, governs the target PSU configuration layout
Exact target PSU list, firmware/VPD/configuration revision, latch-on-fault block location and field width/endianness for that revision
Compatible vendor decoder package/version/hash/license and a documented read-only interface/command with parameters
Protected access, maintenance approval, timeout/abort behavior and recovery owner if the management interface becomes unhealthy
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The PSU/platform owner supplies the applicability matrix, exact spec and expected value; the PSU vendor supplies the decoder and read-only procedure; the BMC/lab owner supplies target mapping, access approval and recovery coverage.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect PSU FRU/model/serial/firmware/VPD identity, BMC PSU status and existing SEL without clearing evidence
Review the supplied specification and decoder documentation offline; verify package hash/license and command read-only semantics without contacting a live PSU
prohibited_until_closed: Do not assume `1248` is a literal table identifier or apply `0002h`/`0008h` to a PSU governed by another revision

Do not blind-scan PMBus/I2C, guess a block address, use a write-capable mode, modify configuration, clear logs, reset/reflash/power-cycle the PSU or declare PASS from a decoder label without raw-field traceability
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The owner signs the exact PSU-to-spec applicability; the expected table entry, field location/encoding and read-only command are peer reviewed; an offline fixture or vendor documentation confirms no write/reset side effect; target/recovery/access approvals are active.

revision_candidate.test_name: CRPS Latch-on-Fault Configuration Block Type Verification
revision_candidate.purpose: Decode the latch-on-fault block's `configBlockType` field and verify it equals the latch-on-fault type defined by the exact specification revision applicable to the target CRPS PSU.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Owner-mapped CRPS PSU models and firmware/configuration revisions with a matching vendor decoder and approved read-only management interface. OCP M-CRPS v1.00 RC4 constants apply only after explicit applicability confirmation.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Each designated PSU's latch-on-fault configuration block and its block-type field only; no configuration write, other-block validation, fault injection, firmware update or generic PMBus scan.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: PSU identity list; authoritative spec title/version/table; configuration format/block location; field offset/width/endianness and expected type; vendor decoder build/hash/license; exact read-only command/target; credentials; approvals; abort and recovery procedure.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify PSU identity and the governing spec, preserve health/log baselines, run only the approved read-only decoder against the specified latch-on-fault block, capture raw bytes and decoded `configBlockType`, compare with the authoritative table, repeat the identical read once, then verify PSU/BMC reachability and evidence deltas. If OCP M-CRPS v1.00 RC4 is confirmed, check block offset `0002h` against Table 12-48 value `0008h`.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Exact PSU/spec mapping approved; target and interface verified; decoder integrity/license and read-only semantics confirmed; field encoding reviewed; credentials protected; evidence destination and recovery owner ready; existing logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Target PSU identity and firmware/VPD/config revision; governing document/version/table; decoder version/hash and command; raw block bytes; field location/encoding; decoded and expected values; repeat-read comparison; exit status; and unchanged PSU/BMC/SEL health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The PSU owner's approved configuration-format specification. For a confirmed OCP M-CRPS v1.00 RC4 target: Section 12.8.3, Table 12-48 Configuration block types and Table 12-57 Power supply latch on fault condition configuration block.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never infer spec applicability, guess address/encoding, scan blindly, use write mode, modify/reflash/reset/power-cycle the PSU, clear logs or expose credentials. A raw value is not PASS until its target, field and table provenance are proven.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: The PSU/platform owner approves the specification mapping and expected value; the BMC/lab owner approves the exact resolved read-only command before live access.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Owners/vendor provide proprietary spec/tool applicability and adjudicate mismatches. After approval, decoding, comparison, repeat read and evidence collection can be automated.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On tool error, unexpected traffic, interface degradation or PSU/BMC health loss, stop immediately, preserve raw/tool/SEL evidence, make no retry/write/reset/power action and follow only the documented management recovery path with separate approval.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unproven spec revision, PSU or block mismatch, unknown encoding, unverified or write-capable tool, target ambiguity, inconsistent repeated value, decoder/raw mismatch, authentication anomaly, new PSU/BMC/SEL fault, reachability loss or incomplete evidence.

identified_defects: The source and V2 use `Table 1248`; the identifiable official OCP M-CRPS reference is Table 12-48.
V2 does not record that OCP M-CRPS v1.00 RC4 maps Latch on Fault condition to `0008h` and locates the field at latch-on-fault block offset `0002h`.
The exact PSU-to-spec applicability remains unconfirmed, so the public constants cannot be universalized.
reason_for_change: Replace an ambiguous table label with a versioned official candidate reference and an auditable field/value comparison, while keeping those constants conditional on the target PSU's approved specification.

new_technical_evidence.title: M-CRPS Base Specification R1 version 1p00 RC4
new_technical_evidence.version: Open Compute Project M-CRPS Version 1.00 Release Candidate 4; accessed 2026-10-13
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Only target CRPS PSUs confirmed by the platform owner to implement this revision
new_technical_evidence.supports: Section 12.8.3 Table 12-48 maps Latch on Fault condition to 0008h. Section 12.8.3.8 Table 12-57 places configBlockType at offset 0002h and refers to Table 12-48.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The repository does not identify the target PSU model/configuration revision or prove that this OCP release candidate is the governing document.

removed_ambiguities: Interprets the run-together `1248` reference as candidate official Table 12-48 rather than an unidentified table number.
Defines the exact conditional field/value comparison and evidence provenance.
resolved_blockers: The technical purpose and a public candidate mapping are identifiable; missing proprietary decoder/target/spec confirmation are provisionable readiness conditions, not permanent BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: No live decode until the owner confirms the exact governing specification, target PSU, field encoding, decoder and read-only command.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 retains V2's correct capability and safety gates but corrects the table reference to official Table 12-48, records the conditional `configBlockType` offset/value from the official M-CRPS document, and prevents those constants from being applied to an unconfirmed PSU revision.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The isolated validator distinguished CRPS configBlockType from adjacent fields, retained two consistent reads per designated PSU and left comparison to the exact specification with the owner.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The row asks for the latch-on-fault configBlockType to be checked against the configuration-block type table.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly reclassified the provisionable decode task but retained the ambiguous `Table 1248` label and no conditional expected value.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Only an owner-approved read-only decode is allowed; official 0002h/0008h constants are used solely after exact spec applicability is proven, with raw bytes and repeat-read evidence.
